The LMS '''Emmy Noether Fellowship''' is a fellowship awarded by the [[London Mathematical Society]].<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|title=LMS Emmy Noether Fellowships {{!}} London Mathematical Society|url=https://www.lms.ac.uk/grants/lms-emmy-noether-fellowships|access-date=2020-12-24|website=www.lms.ac.uk}}</ref>

"The fellowships are designed to enhance the mathematical sciences research, broadly construed, of holders either re-establishing their research programme after returning from a major break associated with caring responsibilities or those requiring support to maintain their research programme while dealing with significant ongoing caring responsibilities.<ref name=":0" />

The fellowship is named after the German mathematician [[Emmy Noether]].

==Winners==
The winners of the LMS Emmy Noether Fellowship have been:

* 2020 - Dr [[Milena Hering]], University of Edinburgh <ref name=":1">{{Cite web|title=LMS Emmy Noether Fellows 2020 Announced {{!}} London Mathematical Society|url=https://www.lms.ac.uk/news-entry/09072020-1421/lms-emmy-noether-fellows-2020-announced|access-date=2020-12-24|website=www.lms.ac.uk}}</ref><ref name=":2">{{Cite news|title=First LMS Emmy Noether Fellowships Announced|work=London Mathematical Society Newsletter|url=https://www.lms.ac.uk/sites/lms.ac.uk/files/files/NLMS_490_for%20web2.pdf}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|title=News - LMS Fellowship won by Milena Hering|url=https://www.maths.ed.ac.uk/school-of-mathematics/news|access-date=2020-12-24|website=School of Mathematics|language=en}}</ref>
*2020 - Dr [[Anne-Sophie Kaloghiros]], Brunel University <ref name=":1" /><ref name=":2" />
*2020 - Dr Irene Kyza, University of Dundee <ref name=":1" /><ref name=":2" /><ref>{{Cite web|title=LMS Emmy Noether Fellowship|url=https://discovery.dundee.ac.uk/en/projects/lms-emmy-noether-fellowship|access-date=2020-12-24|website=Discovery - the University of Dundee Research Portal|language=en}}</ref>
*2020 - Dr [[Cristina Manolache]], University of Sheffield <ref name=":1" /><ref name=":2" />
